name: Teicoplanin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Teicoplanin is a glycopeptide excreted about 80% unchanged in urine, with a very long terminal half-life (100 to 170 hours). The European label gives the full loading dose, then from day 4 halves the maintenance dose at creatinine clearance (CrCl) 30–80 mL/min and gives one-third at CrCl below 30 mL/min and on hemodialysis, guided by trough levels. Hemodialysis does not remove it. It has no US FDA label.
kidney_function_basis: European summary of product characteristics (SmPC) uses creatinine clearance (CrCl, mL/min); thresholds 80 and 30.
chip: From day 4: CrCl 30–80 ½, <30 ⅓ dose

bands.recommendation: CrCl >80: usual loading and maintenance doses (e.g., 6 mg/kg every 12 hours for 3 doses, then 6 mg/kg once daily; 12 mg/kg for bone, joint and endocarditis). CrCl 60–80: no change until day 4, then half the maintenance dose (full dose every 2 days or half dose daily) (SmPC).
Usual loading doses; from day 4, half the maintenance dose: the full dose every 2 days or half the dose once daily (SmPC: CrCl 30–80). Keep trough at least 15 mg/L (FPIA) or 10 mg/L (HPLC).
Usual loading doses; from day 4, one-third of the maintenance dose: the full dose every 3 days or one-third once daily (SmPC: CrCl <30). Guide by trough levels.
Usual loading doses; from day 4, one-third of the maintenance dose (full dose every 3 days or one-third daily) (SmPC). Guide by trough levels.

hd: As for CrCl <30: usual loading, then one-third of the maintenance dose from day 4 (every third day or one-third daily). Not removed by hemodialysis; no supplement needed (SmPC).
pd: CAPD peritonitis: single intravenous loading dose of 6 mg/kg, then 20 mg/L added to dialysate on a 3-week tapering bag schedule (SmPC). Removed only slowly by peritoneal dialysis.
crrt: No CRRT dosing in the SmPC. Use trough-guided dosing; specialist input.
dialyzable: No: not removed by hemodialysis; removed only slowly by peritoneal dialysis (SmPC 4.2, 4.9).
monitoring: Trough concentrations at steady state after loading and at least weekly during maintenance (targets: at least 15 mg/L by FPIA or 10 mg/L by HPLC; 30–40 mg/L FPIA for endocarditis). Kidney function closely in CKD, after high loading doses and with nephrotoxic drugs. Hearing tests with ototoxic or nephrotoxic co-medication. Blood counts periodically (SmPC 4.4).

pediatric.usual_dose: Neonates and infants up to 2 months: 16 mg/kg intravenously on day 1, then 8 mg/kg once daily (infusion only). 2 months to 12 years: 10 mg/kg every 12 hours for 3 doses, then 6 to 10 mg/kg once daily. Over 12 years: adult doses (SmPC).
pediatric.notes: Pediatric half-life about 40 hours in neonates and 58 hours at a mean age of 8 years.

renal.recommendation: Normal kidney function: usual weight-based doses (SmPC).
No pediatric-specific kidney adjustment in the SmPC; adult principle (reduce maintenance from day 4, trough-guided) is a reasonable guide. Specialist input.
